# Geometry-only test face

`geometry-hangul.ttf` is an original, repository-owned synthetic test font. Each supported Hangul syllable has a 1000-unit advance and a rectangular outline. It is not a real Korean typeface and is not evidence of glyph quality or readability. It makes Range-based line-wrap tests independent of installed system fonts. Application fixtures use system sans for Latin text and this face only for Hangul geometry.
